name: Village of Pelham Manor
gaps: No building-coverage limit for residential buildings (only development coverage by lot size, § 210-27.1); no FAR or gross floor area cap
Lot width and depth not set; minimum street frontage recorded
Side yards depend on lot size, not district (§ 210-27.2): 10 ft under 20,000 sf, 15 ft at 20,000 sf+
Front yard can exceed the minimum where an adjoining house is set back further (§§ 210-33A, 210-40A, 210-46A, 210-52A)
MF: no minimum lot area or height in feet; unclear whether § 210-27.1 development coverage applies to the Multifamily District
No wetlands, steep-slope, private tree-removal or ADU law found

wetlands.summary: No local wetlands law found in the Village Code; NYS DEC rules apply to state wetlands.

steep_slopes.summary: No steep-slope law; fill that changes grade by 2 ft or more needs a permit from the Village Manager with an engineer's runoff plan (§ 210-27.4).

trees.summary: No private tree-removal permit; Ch. 197 licenses tree surgeons and requires removal of damaged/diseased trees, and Ch. 160 bars cutting trees without the owner's or Village's consent.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 210 Art. XIX: SWPPP for land development activity disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger common plan).

adu.summary: No accessory apartment law; one-family districts allow living quarters only for full-time household employees (chauffeur, servant, nurse) and their families (§ 210-31C).

general.accessory_structures: Detached accessory buildings max 1 story / 15 ft, at least 2 ft from side and rear lot lines, outside the front setback, 10 ft from other detached buildings (§§ 210-34C, 210-35 and equivalents). Only one garage and one greenhouse per lot.
general.pools: § 210-31F: special permit from the Board of Appeals; not nearer the street than the house; at least 10 ft from side/rear lines plus 2 ft per foot above grade; side setback 10 ft (lots < 20,000 sf) or 15 ft (20,000 sf+) per § 210-27.2; 4 ft fence; landscape screening.
general.notes: Development coverage limit by lot size applies in all residential districts: 45% (< 10,000 sf), 40% (10,000-15,000), 35% (15,000-20,000), 30% (20,000+). Minimum house size 1,200 sf (§ 210-24).

R-AAA.name: Residence AAA District

max_impervious_coverage.note: Development coverage (§ 210-27.1): buildings, structures, paving, gravel, pools, ponds, patios, decks, gazebos

accessory.notes: Detached accessory buildings (max 1 story / 15 ft by definition) may be 2 ft from side/rear lot lines; front-yard setback applies; 10 ft between detached buildings

R-AAA.notes: Side yard 15 ft (lots of 20,000 sf+; 10 ft on smaller pre-existing lots, § 210-27.2). Corner lot: one side yard 15 ft, the other 25 ft (§ 210-34B). Front yard is at least the stated minimum or the setback of the nearest building on an adjoining lot, whichever is greater. A new house on a vacant lot, a rebuild of 50%+, or an addition of 500 sf+ needs a Board of Appeals special permit; if the lot sits 7+ ft above a neighbor, add 5 ft to each side yard per story above the first (§ 210-27.3).

MF.name: Multifamily District
MF.notes: Residence B uses (incl. one-family) and multifamily houses permitted. Front 35 ft (50 ft on Boston Post Road); 30 ft from any non-street lot line (20 ft for internal lines more than 30 ft inside the district); 2.5 stories; multifamily max 20% coverage and 1 unit per 3,000 sf; development plan approval by the Planning Board for buildings with more than two families.
